study_design: Prospective cohort analysis of UK Biobank participants who were cancer-free at recruitment.
reason: The abstract reports incident prostate cancer overall but does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In men, being a fish-eater or a vegetarian was associated with a lower risk of prostate cancer (0.80, 0.65-0.99 and 0.69, 0.54-0.89, respectively).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer among men, with no aggressive endpoint specified.
